name: Military
description: You serve in the military forces of your clan. Males in Military service are fighters or combatants; females are support personnel.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: You are a front-line warrior in the clan forces.

cavalry.name: Cavalry
cavalry.description: You drive a grav tank or other combat vehicle.

support.name: Support
support.description: You are a mechanic, medic, commtech or other support engineer.

mishaps.1: Severely injured. Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: A superior officer has you drummed out of the service. Gain a Rival.
mishaps.3: You are lost behind enemy lines. Gain Stealth 1, Survival 1, Streetwise 1 or Gun Combat 1.
mishaps.4: You are captured and ransomed back to your clan. Lose SOC −1.
mishaps.5: You risk severe injury in a dangerous skirmish. If you fight bravely, roll Gun Combat or Athletics 8+. If you fail, you are injured and must leave this career. If you succeed, you may remain in this career. If you refuse to fight bravely, you must leave this career.
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: Your unit is sent into the maw of hell. Roll Recon or Gun Combat 8+ to avoid rolling on the Injury table and gain one of Stealth 1, Medic 1, Heavy Weapons 1 or Leadership 1 as you fight to survive.
events.4: You are assigned to garrison duty on a clan outpost. Gain a Contact there or one of the following skills: Streetwise 1, Electronics (Comms) 1 or Mechanic 1.
events.5: You are involved in a border skirmish with another clan. Gain one of Melee (Natural) 1, Gun Combat 1, Drive 1 or Survival 1, then roll that skill. If you get an 8+, your clan is victorious — gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll.
events.6: You are given advanced training in a specialist field. Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Aslan Life Events table.
events.8: You fight against an alien race. Gain one of Gun Combat 1, Language 1, Melee 1, Recon 1 or Survival 1.
events.9: An officer insults your courage. You may either duel them or try to prove them wrong. If you duel, roll Melee (Natural) 8+. If you succeed, gain SOC +1. If you fail, lose SOC −1. If you instead try to prove them wrong, roll 1D: on 1–3, you are wounded — roll on the Injury table. On 4+, you perform heroically under fire — gain them as a Rival, DM+4 to your next advancement roll and SOC +1.
events.10: You are considered for promotion in the officer caste. You may add the number of terms served in this career as a DM if you attempt to qualify for the Military Officer career next term, and may apply even if you have not served the minimum number of terms in this career.
events.11: You serve under a hero of the clan. Either gain Tactics (Military) 1, or DM+4 to any advancement roll thanks to their aid.
events.12: Your efforts strike a great blow for your clan. You are automatically promoted.

mustering_dm_notes: DM+1 if SOC 9+. DM+1 when rolling on Benefits if Male.
